key_insight: GenToka uses one generative multimodal foundation model to support plasma reconstruction, forecasting, actuator inference, and disruption prediction.
engineering_relevance: A shared model adaptable to different input-output schemas could reduce reliance on separate task-specific models for tokamak prediction and control research.
method: Jointly generates schema-selected targets with a shared conditional diffusion Transformer.
Uses signal-specific codecs for time series, profiles, fields, and scalars.
Transfers cross-signal structure through foundation pretraining and task-specific adaptation.
evidence_signal: Across 20 MAST tasks in six groups, GenToka reduced macro-average normalized RMSE versus TokaMind by 4.7% on Groups 1–4 and 17.7% on Group 5, and improved macro-average window-level F1 by 8.4% on Group 6 at a common validation-selected threshold.
watch_item: Evaluation is reported on MAST measurements; transfer to other tokamaks and operational control settings remains to be demonstrated.
paper_title: A Generative Foundation Model for Multimodal Tokamak Tasks
